name: binder
evidence: 360 0x8284e078 formats model_ac:\motion\%s%s\%s (string 0x82044d2c) from an empty string and boost (0x820267bc). 0x8284e9d8 calls it at 0x8284ec18 and stores the bank at the anim controller +0x90c. boost_la.bnd.dcx is the light set (flag 0x2000 when vtable +0x2c is nonzero, else 0x100); _a is the set played, as for the body motions

name: clip
evidence: AC_MOTIONINFO.BoosterAnimID is the byte at +8. 0x82882d80 reads it into the anim command at +0x14 along with the body clip's start time and Booster_Frame. 0 is the rest pose (1 frame), 1 and 3 are direction wheels (360 frames, a key every 45), 2 is a held pose (1 frame; jump and rise), 4 is the high-boost wheel (360 frames, a key every 5). Clip 1 is the ground dash / ground glide (acmotion rows 17-40 and 218). Clip 3 is the air glide float (row 222, 空中浮遊); the air-glide entries (rows 223-230) stay on clip 1

name: wheel
expr: frame = heading when the clip has 360 frames, else 0
evidence: The command start time is the body lean fraction from 0x82883870 (atan2, then 1 minus the fraction of the turn). A 360-frame booster clip is the same kind of wheel as the body lean: the frame is degrees clockwise from forward. While that body wheel is playing the nozzles use its eased frame; otherwise they ease toward the velocity heading

name: blend
evidence: ACANIM_HOKANPARAM_ST Booster_Frame is the s16 at +0x10. 0x82882d80 converts it to float for the command at +0x1c. Read as milliseconds, the same as the other hokan columns (anim_blend.csv). Dash and flight are 15, idle is 120

name: rotation
expr: mounted rotation plus the parent-space change from the clip rest
evidence: a00_000 is named and its keys match its rest eulers, so it is the rest pose. The other clips store absolute local rotations of r_boost, l_boost, r2_boost and l2_boost in that order. The mounted joint keeps the attach orientation (assembly_slots.csv flag 3) and adds that change. Clip translations are the reference body's bone positions and are not applied
